card.name: Modifier slot before an expected noun
card.fires_on: Small modifier or linking words (special, particular, more, the, be, to) sitting just before an expected abstract noun such as reference, attention, familiar or health. Seen mostly in older formal prose, with a few label sentences.

modes.label: Adjective before noun
modes.description: Words like special, particular, bodily or spiritual that precede a noun such as reference, attention or health.

modes.label: Small linking word
modes.description: Words like the, be, to or more in the middle of a formal sentence, before the main noun or verb.
modes.example: Repeated evaluation of<< the>> patient's condition is essential.

card.plain: It fires on a small word in the middle of a formal phrase, when the next word is a predictable abstract noun.
